name: TC Math Evaluator
description: Safe arithmetic expression evaluator for path pipelines. AST-validated, zero dependencies, stdlib math only.
description_zh: 路径管道用安全算术求值器。AST 校验，零依赖，仅用 math 标准库。

directives.description: Safely evaluate an arithmetic expression. Supports sqrt, sin, cos, tan, log, log10, abs, ceil, floor, round, pi, e, +, -, *, /, **, (, ).
directives.description_zh: 安全求算术表达式。支持 sqrt/sin/cos/tan/log/log10/abs/ceil/floor/round/pi/e 和基本运算符。
